compared: DSH-geom-normal-fan-subdiv claims Prop:NormalFan, which describes the normal fan of K_omega; this proposition describes the polytope itself, its facets and its face lattice. The normal-fan statement is a different assertion and is not used by this proof.
A-2039-associahedral-magic-formula and DSH-geom-transition-map claim results about the diagonal and about transition maps; neither is the facet and face-lattice description claimed here.
The label prop:PropertiesKLoday and its five clause labels are free in the corpus after normalisation.
